Work at East Room

East Room was founded in 2014 with the vision to develop an environment that enhances the personal and professional well-being of our members and extended community through intentional design, authentic programming, diverse community, and exceptional hospitality.

Get in touch with us

Submit this form and one of our community managers will get in touch if we have any available opportunities.

Get in Touch

Mission

Our mission is to develop an environment where work and life intersect through intentional design, authentic programming, diverse community and exceptional hospitality.

Meet our Team

Danielle Cugliari, Sales Director

Tell us what you do?

I help build East Room's vital and growing community. An integral aspect of my role is to foster relationships and understand everyones current and future needs. In turn, contributing to the overall growth of each member who comes in our doors.

How did you end up working for East Room?

I've always had a love for design and immediately fell in love with East Room's unique and inspiring aesthetic. Soon after realizing that East Room was far more than just a beautiful space and wanted to have a hand in a company that is united by a passion for culture, creativity and community.

What is your biggest learning so far?

Not to sound too cliché, but the power of community and the impact of genuine hospitality. East Room feels like a home away from home which is a result of the individuals here and the authentic relationships that subsequently develop.

What is your favourite aspect of working for East Room?

Creating shared experiences and connections. It's incredibly fulfilling to have an impact on a diverse membership base and watch our members work come to life.

Bailey Melville, Operations Director

Oversee all aspects of East Room! From managing our community teams, all of our locations to implementing and developing procedures that support the overall business strategy.

It's been a while now! I heard about East Room through colleagues of the job I worked at the time, had an interview and got the position. At the time, I was studying in design, so I fell in love with the space, stuck around and here we are years later!

Going with the flow! As many systems as we can put in place to get ahead and foresee situations, working with so many unique individuals shows that sometimes there isn't one solution for everything. I've learned how to develop approaches that can be molded to fit each person's needs.

There's never a dull moment! From our team, the community, to the work I do on a daily basis. There is always something new and exciting happening.

Kassidy Finucan, Brand Director

As Brand Manager, I do a little bit of everything to shape East Room’s identity! Whether that be managing our social media, planning programming and events for members, building partnerships and more.

I had heard about East Room a few times at my last job and all the exciting things that went on there. After attending an event, I became curious about what a career at East Room could actually look like — and now we’re here!

Adaptability is key! In a world where changes occur daily, it’s crucial to anticipate the future and stay three steps ahead.

Getting to meet so many interesting people! Fostering great relationships is key to my role, and it's amazing to see the constant outpuring of support we get from our friends and business partners all over.

Laima Alawi, Event Operations Director

I am the Events Operations Director at East Room. My role involves coordinating events and ensuring the smooth day-to-day operations of our shared workspace and events.

I came to East Room in a somewhat unconventional way - I used to work as a server at a local Italian restaurant where the owners of East Room were regular customers. One day, they reached out to me on social media with a job offer, and I jumped at the opportunity to join their team.

What is your biggest learing so far?

One of the biggest things I've learned since joining the East Room team is the importance of adaptability and creativity in a fast-paced, constantly-evolving industry. Working at East Room has challenged me to think outside the box, come up with innovative solutions, and pivot quickly when needed.

My favourite aspect of working for East Room is the people. I feel incredibly lucky to work for such supportive and encouraging owners who truly care about their employees and their community. It's a great feeling to be a part of something that is making a positive impact in the lives of our members and the broader community.

Lillian Blasioli, Community Director

As a Community Director, I strive to ensure that all members are welcomed into a space that is ran efficiently and effortlessly. As a first point of contact, it is my role to attend to the needs, inquiries and general comfort of new and existing members.

I worked for a company that catered for East Room, and it was exciting to come back to the space wondering what event they were having next. At a time where I was craving a job change, the stars aligned when I found out East Room was hiring!

Having a go-getter mentality. Our community has taught me that to put actions into place is by having the confidence to take that first step forward. Being surrounded by creatives in all fields and witnessing them find ways to connect and collaborate has been inspiring.

Being able to converse with such an array of personalities everyday. You can feel that supportive & enthusiastic energy with everyone you come in contact with. I feel fortunate to have the opportunity to be surrounded by diverse industries in my day-to-day life.

Brielle Ford, Experience Manager

I get to know our Members and their businesses and help facilitate their growth. I focus on maintaining a welcoming environment with exceptional service, where Members feel at ease, supported and productive.

I was looking for a professional change and found East Room - the change felt right from the first day.

Hard work, honesty and transparency goes a long way!

I love learning about Member's companies and businesses, especially the small ones. Our community is vibrant, diverse, and fun, and I feel grateful to enjoy what I do for work every day.

Veronica Ha, Sales Manager

Aside from being the first face you see when you come into the space, I foster a collaborative environment for our members. I handle day-to-day operations and support our community by ensuring they have the resources and connections they need to thrive.

Luckily for me a friend had reached out with an opportunity at East Room. Being surrounded by the beautiful space and team, it was a no brainer to join!

My biggest learning at East Room has been the true value of community and the importance of feeling supported by your team, whether you're a member or an employee. It’s a space where everyone looks out for each other, and that sense of connection makes all the difference in both personal and professional growth.

The authentic relationships that form here are what make the experience special, and I’ve learned that fostering these connections is key to creating a meaningful and welcoming environment.

Our Values

Put customers first

Be famous for friendly service. Care for people so that they can be their best. Focus on the customer and all else will follow.

Make a difference in our communities

Our locations are not insular, they are diverse connecting points for the broader community as well as our members. We strive to be a social, economic and cultural beacon in the neighbourhoods we inhabit.

We are one team

Our members and staff make the difference. By sharing our skills, knowledge and experience we become one team. Diversity makes us strong.

Strive for continuous improvement

Our work is never done. We work collectively to continuously improve our operations and productivity through a gradual, methodical and resourceful process.
